name: Yong Bu Tingxi de Hei'an zhi Ge
source:
This is a fan-made game for "Alien Stage," created as a tribute to the world of "The Song of Saya." It is a coupling-focused game centered on the "IvanTill" pairing.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3707780/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
本作是《外星人舞臺》的同人遊戲，向《沙耶之歌》的世界觀致敬，以伊凡×蒂爾（IvanTill）這對搭檔為主角。

［摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3707780/]Steam[/url]］
